hero.description: Browser extensions and mobile apps designed for real people. Simple, useful, and focused on what matters to you.

about.name: Sergei Ponomarev
paragraphs: I create software that solves real problems for real people. My products are designed to be intuitive, reliable, and genuinely useful in your daily life.
From browser extensions that save you time to apps that help you grow personally, I focus on building things that make a meaningful difference.
I believe great software should be accessible to everyone, not just tech experts. That's why I prioritize simplicity and user experience in everything I build.

items.title: Screenshot YouTube Maker

items.title: Your QR Code Generator

decider.name: The Decider
decider.tagline: A digital circuit-breaker for thought loops. Turn hard choices into fast, tactile micro-games — no AI, no tracking.
decider.introDescription: An interactive preview of The Decider, running right here in your browser. Pick something you’re stuck on and let one of its decision engines call it for you. Coming soon to mobile.

enter.title:
Deciding,
made easy.
enter.sub: Quick, satisfying nudges that pull the decision out of your gut.
enter.foot: no menus · no AI · fully offline

hub.title:
Let's not
overthink this.
hub.sub: Tap what you're stuck on — I'll call it in seconds.

gut.countdownLabel: Sit with it… flinch? hit nope

blind.hint: Tap a card to rule it out — the last one left is your answer
blind.finalHint: One left — this is your answer. Lock it in, or if you secretly miss one below, grab it instead.
blind.ruledOutSwitchHint: Ruled out · tap one to switch to it
blind.ruledOutMissHint: Ruled out · miss one? tap it — that's your answer

result.note: That's the one. Don't look back — just go.
